stories.title: Mumbai local train update: Mega block on central, Harbour and Western Railway lines today; services to be affected
stories.summary: Central Railway will conduct a mega block on the suburban network for maintenance purposes. The block will impact services on the Main and Harbour lines, with specified timeframes for disruptions. Fast and semi-fast services will be diverted to slow corridors and may face delays.
